movie.title: Second Sister
movie.overview: High school student 'Ji-eun' was the victim of the crime, but distorted online posts and malicious comments made her into the perpetrator in the public eye, driving her to take her own life. Her sister 'So-eun' finds detective 'Jun-kyung' to uncover the truth behind her sister's unfair death, and he begins hunting down a suspect in cyberspace. As clues are revealed one by one, the case grows from a simple rumor into a complex web of truth involving anonymous accounts.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When distorted online rumors push a high school girl to take her own life, her devastated older sister teams up with a detective to hunt down the anonymous cyber perpetrators.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After high school student Ji-eun dies by suicide following a wave of malicious online harassment that falsely portrayed her as a perpetrator, her sister So-eun refuses to let the truth remain buried. She enlists detective Jun-kyung to investigate the origin of the cyberbullying and bring the real culprits to justice. As Jun-kyung tracks the trail of digital clues across cyberspace, he uncovers a malicious web of anonymous accounts. Together, they fight to restore Ji-eun's reputation and expose the dark reality of cyber violence.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Ji-eun, a victimized high school student, finds herself falsely blamed and villainized after distorted posts and toxic comments go viral across social media. Overwhelmed by unrelenting public condemnation and cyberbullying, Ji-eun tragically ends her own life. Heartbroken and outraged by the injustice, her older sister So-eun seeks help from detective Jun-kyung to clear Ji-eun's name. Jun-kyung launches a targeted investigation into cyberspace, systematically pursuing the anonymous accounts and cyber attackers responsible for spreading the rumors. As the investigation progresses, what initially appeared to be simple high school gossip unravels into a far more sinister network of malicious intent. Clues surface one by one, exposing how online anonymity allowed bad actors to manipulate public perception and ruin an innocent life. Facing complex digital obstacles and hidden identities, Jun-kyung and So-eun press forward to hold the orchestrators accountable. Ultimately, the relentless pursuit highlights the devastating consequences of cyber crime and the fierce bond between sisters seeking closure.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Second Sister is a gripping crime thriller drama that delves into the dark side of social media, online anonymity, and mob mentality. Following the tragic suicide of high school student Ji-eun—who was driven to despair when online rumors turned her from victim to perpetrator—her sister So-eun seeks justice. Teaming up with detective Jun-kyung, they embark on a cyber hunt to track down the digital mob and reveal the truth behind Ji-eun's death.

story_structure.climax: The investigation reaches a critical tipping point when Jun-kyung and So-eun confront the true orchestrator behind the cyber campaign, forcing a high-stakes showdown where digital evidence must be exposed despite severe pressure to bury the truth.
story_structure.conflict: Jun-kyung launches an investigation to track down the primary suspect in cyberspace, but faces the overwhelming challenge of cutting through pervasive online anonymity, widespread public misinformation, and hostile cyber harassment.
story_structure.resolution: The real facts surrounding Ji-eun's tragic fate are exposed, vindicating her memory. So-eun finds a sense of closure while the systemic dangers and human cost of cyber violence and online anonymity are brought into stark focus.
story_structure.introduction: High school student Ji-eun tragicaly takes her own life after being falsely branded a perpetrator online due to malicious posts and cyberbullying. Driven by grief and a desire to uncover the truth behind her unfair death, her sister So-eun seeks out detective Jun-kyung.
story_structure.risingAction: As Jun-kyung digs deeper into the digital trails and anonymous accounts, he uncovers a far more complex web of secrets. Clues slowly connect simple online rumors to deliberate manipulation, unraveling hidden motives and expanding the scope of the case beyond a single bad actor.
